carry.implied.meaning: Continuous carry rate the option chain implies through put-call parity, annualised: the dividend-yield-like term of the forward
carry.implied.tenor: expiry nearest 75 days between 45 and 120, else the one nearest 30

event.confirmed.meaning: 1 when the next earnings date is confirmed, 0 when it is estimated

event.days.meaning: Calendar days from the card's session to the next listed earnings date

garch.avg.21.meaning: Average annualised volatility the fitted GARCH model forecasts over the next 21 sessions

garch.grade.meaning: The GARCH fit's own robustness grade, 0 to 3, carried as a count

garch.halfLife.meaning: Sessions for a volatility shock to decay by half under the fitted GARCH persistence

gex.book.meaning: Dealers' book gamma in dollars per 1% move of the underlying, on the vendor's convention (dealers long calls, short puts)

gex.flow.meaning: Net gamma of today's option flow in dollars per 1% move of the underlying, on the vendor's convention

iv.cm.30.meaning: At-the-money implied volatility interpolated in total variance to a constant 30-day maturity from the fitted expiry slices

iv.cm.7.meaning: At-the-money implied volatility interpolated in total variance to a constant 7-day maturity from the fitted expiry slices

iv.cm.90.meaning: At-the-money implied volatility interpolated in total variance to a constant 90-day maturity from the fitted expiry slices

iv.pct.30.meaning: The same min-max rank as iv.rank.1y, stored under a percentile-looking id before iv.pctile.30.1y existed: a rank and not a percentile, kept for stored cards until it is retired

iv.pctile.30.1y.meaning: Percentile of today's 30-day implied volatility within its own past year of readings, as the volatility cone reports it from its 251-sample history

iv.rank.1y.meaning: Min-max rank of the 30-day implied volatility within its own past year, from the priced-move panel: 0 at the one-year low, 1 at the one-year high

level.callWall.meaning: Strike at or above spot with the largest call gamma open interest in the vendor's strike book

level.flip.meaning: Price at which the dealer gamma profile recomputed from the chain crosses zero, on the vendor's convention (dealers long calls, short puts)

level.flip.count.meaning: How many times the recomputed dealer gamma profile changes sign across the price grid

level.flowPeakLong.meaning: Strike with the largest net long gamma from today's option flow, from the card's gamma panel

level.flowPeakShort.meaning: Strike with the largest net short gamma from today's option flow, from the card's gamma panel

level.magnet.meaning: Strike with the largest absolute dealer-book gamma, calls plus signed puts, on the vendor's convention (dealers long calls, short puts)

level.maxPain.meaning: Max-pain strike of the expiry the card's levels panel names

level.putWall.meaning: Strike at or below spot with the largest absolute put gamma open interest in the vendor's strike book

level.strikeSumCrossing.meaning: Price at which gamma summed strike by strike changes sign, from the card

move.event.meaning: Option-implied mean absolute earnings move: the jump the two expiries around the event price beyond diffusion

move.event.hist.medianAbs.meaning: Median absolute one-day move over the name's past earnings reactions, from at least three of them

move.event.ratio.meaning: move.event over move.event.hist.medianAbs: the earnings move the options price against the name's own history

move.mad..meaning: Mean-absolute-deviation implied move to the expiry named by the suffix, as a fraction of spot, on the expiry nearest 30 days
move.mad..tenor: to the expiry in the suffix

rv.cc.21.meaning: Close-to-close realised volatility over the last 21 sessions, from the priced-move panel's rv30 field

skew.bf25.30.meaning: 25-delta butterfly: the mean of the 25-delta put and call implied volatilities less the at-the-money one, on the expiry nearest 30 days

skew.rr25.30.meaning: 25-delta risk reversal: the 25-delta put's implied volatility less the 25-delta call's, on the expiry nearest 30 days

skew.rr25.30.pct.meaning: Share of the names screened that night whose 25-delta risk reversal sits at or below this name's: a rank among screened names, not a history of the name's own

term.front.7_30.meaning: The 7-day constant-maturity implied volatility over the 30-day one, less 1: positive when the very front is bid

term.slope.30_90.meaning: The 30-day constant-maturity implied volatility over the 90-day one, less 1: positive when the front is the richer end

term.slope.30_90.exEvent.meaning: term.slope.30_90 with the variance of the earnings jump removed from every maturity that spans the event date

vrp.rel.21.meaning: vrp.vol.21 as a share of the GARCH average volatility: how much richer implied volatility is than the model's forecast, relative

vrp.trailing.21.meaning: 30-day constant-maturity implied volatility less the trailing 21-session realised volatility, a backward-looking premium

vrp.var.21.meaning: Implied variance at 30 days, earnings removed when known, less the GARCH average variance of the next 21 sessions, annualised

vrp.vol.21.meaning: Implied volatility at 30 days, earnings removed when known, less the GARCH average volatility of the next 21 sessions
